detail.longDescription: A recent find from an old luggage shop turned into an experiment in historical analysis. I provided black-and-white photographs of a British Airways cabin baggage placard to my AI committee and instructed it to be conservative, explain all deductions, and clearly distinguish evidence from speculation. The article is less about the final date and more about the reasoning process. https://www. alanbonnici.com/2026/08/cabin- baggage-british-airways-concord.html # Aviation # BritishAirways # Concorde # History # AI # Research # TTMO
